about: The thresholds of the layout check's two craft findings ([[BUG-238]]). Both
are defaults builders get wrong again and again, so the host measures them
rather than trusting a reminder in the priming.
`brand`: the header is the page's first section when it holds a link.
`logoMinPx` is the least height its logo image may render at, per width the
page is checked at (`desktop`, `phone`). `nameOverNav` is how much larger
than the navigation links the business name must be to read as the header's
`heading`: a heading belongs to the text it introduces, so the space below it
must be clearly smaller than the space above it. It is reported when the
space below is at least `belowOverAbove` times the space above. A space above
under `minAbovePx` is tight spacing, not a floating heading, and is not
reported: 16 keeps an 8px-and-8px heading out while catching 20px above and
The numbers are starting values to tune, not measurements.
